not_found: Menu numbering on the English page skips #2 (no pizza 2 listed). Sizes offered: 9", 12", 16" plus 12" Gluten-Free (gluten-free prices not captured). Ítalinn and Lúdent (Daddi's Specials) exist only in 9" and 12" (no 16" option). The IS and EN pages differ in wording (EN 'salami' = IS 'pepperoni') - each kept verbatim. Ítalinn has no English text on the source (only Icelandic), so desc_en is empty. Build-your-own ('Veldu sjálfur') is the Margarita base with toppings; Margarita included as a standard pizza. Offers/combos, breadsticks, dessert breadsticks, cheesy garlic pizza excluded. Own-site hours 12-21 vs GTI 12-22: own site used.

restaurant.name: Daddi's Pizza Mývatn
restaurant.description_is: Fjölskyldurekin pítsustaður við Mývatn, stofnaður 2009, í Vogum við móttöku Vogar Travel Service. Býður pizzur með staðbundnu áleggi eins og reyktum Mývatnssilungi.
restaurant.description_en: Family-run pizzeria by Lake Mývatn, founded in 2009 and located next to the Vogar Travel Service reception. Serves pizzas including a local topping of smoked Lake Mývatn trout.
